page.overview:
Who is Syltrack?

Admiral Syltrack was a Starfleet flag officer in the late 24th century.

In 2380, Syltrack selected an "elite team" from the , composed of Captain Carol Freeman, Jack Ransom and Shaxs to liaise with a Pisepian agricultural colony on a mission related to rulot seeds. ()
